notes: New: Guest forms can now fill in more of the booking, including the guest's name and email, the number of adults and children, pets, and vehicles and boats.
New: Forms can have a "No pets" or "No vehicles or boats" answer, and the booking shows "None" when a guest said so.
New: Any form answer can be added to the booking's notes.
Improved: When you build a form, the "Saves to" list is now grouped (Guest, Stay, Pets, Vehicles and boats and so on), so it's easier to find what you need.
Improved: Guest forms start with the guest's name and email already filled in.
Improved: More kinds of fields, such as dropdowns, Yes or no and number fields, can now fill in the booking.
Improved: You can now save several form answers into the booking's notes in the same form.
Fixed: A "Yes or no" answer of "No" no longer ticks "agreed to the house rules" or "at least the minimum age" on the booking.
